scripts.build: npm install && npm run build:netlify-functions && npm run generate-tsconfig:render && tsc --noEmit
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm install && npm run build:netlify-functions && npm run generate-tsconfig:cloudflare && tsc --noEmit
scripts.build:render: npm install && npm run build:netlify-functions && npm run generate-tsconfig:render && tsc --noEmit
scripts.docs:generate-static: cd public/documentation && npm install && cd ../.. && node scripts/simple-static-generator.js && node scripts/update-docsify-links.js
scripts.build:netlify-functions: cd netlify/functions && npm install && npm run postinstall
scripts.netlify:dev: npm run check-netlify-health || echo 'Warning: Netlify health check failed, but continuing...' && netlify dev
scripts.netlify:dev:safe: echo 'Starting Netlify dev in safe mode...' && netlify dev || echo 'Netlify dev failed - check netlify-cli installation'
scripts.netlify:build: (npm run check-netlify-health:build || echo 'Warning: Netlify health check failed, but continuing build...') && npm run build:netlify-functions && npm run build
